selection_constraints: Membership uses only statement text, starter API, source metadata, and public test count.
No private outcome, model output, or prior P3/P5 per-task result was used for membership.
Each selected row declares its source execution mode and every method uses that mode.

groups.name: simple_single_stage
groups.selection_rule: Unrun original holdout rows with one dominant transformation or formula and no required independent helper boundary.

selected.rationale: Fixed lookup and direct probability computation.
One prescribed arithmetic formula.
Sort once and format one selected value.
Single left-to-right expression evaluation loop.
One relative-speed calculation and time formatting.
One recurrence until a scalar stopping condition.
One aggregate followed by per-key arithmetic.
Single substitution mapping over characters.
One ordered character transformation.
One list-formatting rule with edge cases.
One scalar iteration with a repeated digit-square transform.
One depth-tracking scan of parentheses.
One scan for maximal numeric token.
Direct implementation of one named sorting algorithm.
One score accumulation rule.
One frequency-pair consistency check.
One repeated-substring decision.
One character-boundary formatting scan.
One grade-school array addition procedure.
One frequency-difference computation.

groups.name: medium_multi_stage
groups.selection_rule: New unscored function rows with several transformations, but at least one coupled state or ambiguous helper boundary.

selected.rationale: Bound generation and product-sum search share a coupled global minimum table.
Encoding requires stateful run processing and output rules.
Palindrome search combines expansion state with global tie handling.
Digit interleaving, stopping rules, and sequence selection are coupled.
Character filtering, counting, comparison, and output ordering are distinct but coupled by the same counts.
Factor decomposition and ordered-count aggregation share recursive state.
Digit-bound handling and combinatorial counting require shared prefix state.
Base91 character decoding uses paired parsing and stateful byte assembly.
Square classification combines number-theoretic cases and a minimum search.
Automorphic-number generation combines suffix tests with ordered enumeration.
Ring state evolution and meeting detection share modular timing state.
Transition-table handling and terminal-state policy are coupled in one FSM.
Constrained digit generation and result summary require shared enumeration bounds.
Consecutive-run detection and range formatting are coupled by boundary semantics.
Unit decomposition, omission rules, and English joining rules interact.
Recursive pair evaluation and digit formatting share numerical precision rules.
Expression parsing, missing-digit search, and arithmetic validity are coupled.
Subsequence dynamic programming updates depend on the full target state.
Term tokenization, canonicalization, aggregation, and sorting are multi-stage but tightly coupled.
Attack geometry and legal-move classification interact on each board square.

groups.name: hard_naturally_decomposable
groups.selection_rule: New unscored hard stdin rows with named processing stages and independently specifiable helper contracts.

selected.rationale: Classify two edge weights, construct an MST policy, then answer root-to-node path objectives.
Decompose X into constructible blocks, assign separated values, then emit a valid array.
Transform geometric inequalities to an ordering relation, then compute a longest chain.
Implement a time-feasibility matcher and search the minimum feasible time.
Identify binary runs, resolve their eventual states, then format the stabilized sequence.
Derive the matrix value rule, build a rectangle prefix query helper, then process queries.
Analyze graph structure under the no-immediate-backtrack rule, then aggregate reachable scores.
Derive a partition criterion and apply it to the sequence construction/checking stage.
Encode cyclic necklace constraints, count valid arrangements, then aggregate the requested result.
Construct candidate permutations from remembered constraints and validate the phone-number condition.
Parse click outcomes, simulate score-state transitions, then compute the final classification.
Model timer transitions and combine the independent game-state cases.
Maintain interval geometry after each falling stone and compute the surviving measure.
Separate complete-graph route cost calculation from the final optimization over choices.
Canonicalize rooted substructures and apply the tree-minimization recurrence.
Root and encode each tree, then compare canonical representations.
Compute geometric relations among points and aggregate the valid polygon contributions.
Build bracket state transitions and answer tournament outcomes from that representation.
Simulate elevator capacity/state rules and compute schedule completion time.
Parse quantified conditions, evaluate their mathematical cases, and produce the requested decision.
